description: Mandatory deterministic fixture (CLAUDE.md, docs/07 §3). Canonical state hashes for the fixed seed + DEFAULT_CONFIG + empty command log. Intentional engine behavior changes require an ENGINE_VERSION bump, regenerated hashes (pnpm headless --seed 0xE0A12026 --ticks 10000 --checkpoints 0,1,10,100,1000,10000) and a CHANGELOG entry. Engine 0.5.0 regenerated every hash for two independent reasons: the carcass store joined the canonical stream, and three new config fields moved the config digest. The reference world also behaves differently from tick 1 onward — the carcass sensors report real carrion instead of a pinned absence, which changes the founder's eat output whenever a body is nearby (ADR 0008 §5).
